description: Texas sources for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/data-policy.md, docs/registry/collection.md, and the review record in docs/registry/texas-sources.md.

sources.license: Public record (Tex. Gov't Code ch. 552); no license or terms of use stated for the downloads
sources.redistribution: Not addressed by the publisher; public record
sources.notes: The downloads page (hcad.org/pdata/pdata-property-downloads.html) is filled by the JSON endpoints listed as landing pages; the files live on download.hcad.org. Each tax year has its own folder (data/CAMA/<year>/), which holds the preliminary values first and the certified values later under the same file names (HCAD's page script labels a year 'Preliminary Values' until get-certification-flag?t=<year> returns certflg Y). The 2027 files the adapter reads are listed ahead of time so the weekly run archives the spring 2027 preliminary roll as soon as it is posted; until then they answer 404 (on 2026-11-06 get-property-downloads?t=2027 returned null and get-tax-years listed 2026 back to at least 2007). The 2026 files stay listed: they are the certified roll of the year being protested. The adapters load each tax year as its own registry source (store.roll_source), so the 2027 files do not retire the 2026 facts. See registry/sources/tx/PROTEST-SEASON.md. robots.txt on hcad.org has no active rules; download.hcad.org has none.

sources.license: Public record; no license or terms of use stated. The page only notes that DCAD cannot provide technical support for use of the data
sources.redistribution: Not addressed by the publisher; public record
sources.notes: Links are ViewPDFs.aspx with a UNC path in the query string (backslashes and spaces), percent-encoded here. DCAD2027_CURRENT.zip is the most current ownership file; DCAD<year>_CURRENT.ZIP is that year's certified data with supplemental changes; the _CERTIFIED_<date> file is the roll at certification. Each zip ships its own layout documents. robots.txt disallows only staff/test paths and /Acct detail pages.

sources.license: Public record; no license or terms of use stated for the exports (the privacy policy covers website use only)
sources.redistribution: Not addressed by the publisher; public record
sources.notes: robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 10, which the collector honours. The certified export is about 557 MB; the supplemental export file name changes with each supplement, so re-run discover to pick up the current one.

sources.license: Public record; no license or terms of use stated for the downloads
sources.ai_use: robots.txt (www.tad.org) for generic agents: "Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference". The publisher reserves rights against AI training. use=reference is not defined by the Content-Signal vocabulary, and ai-input is not stated, so whether serving the data to AI agents is allowed is unclear; until that is clarified FactLot does not serve Tarrant comparables (registry_tx_equity_candidates). The registry does not train models on this data
sources.redistribution: Not addressed by the publisher; public record
sources.notes: robots.txt allows all paths for generic agents and disallows a list of named AI crawlers (the FactLot bot is not among them). PropertyData(Delimited)_C.ZIP is the commercial-only extract; 000_Tarrant_All_Taxing_Units.zip is the full True Prodigy extract. Prior certified years are also published (PropertyData_<year>(Certified).ZIP).

No bulk appraisal-roll download was found on bcad.org on 2026-11-02 (home page, reports, taxpayer resources, sitemap). Property search is hosted at hgo.harrisgovern.com, which is not a bulk source. Candidate for a Public Information Act request (docs/registry/public-information-requests.md).

sources.license: Public record; no license or terms of use stated for the exports
sources.redistribution: Not addressed by the publisher; public record
sources.notes: Files are served from link.collincad.org (a file-share host; no robots.txt). LiteDatabaseCurrent.zip is about 50 MB. Collin also publishes GIS data on an ArcGIS Hub (open-data-ccad.hub.arcgis.com), not yet catalogued.

sources.publisher: Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts (via the Texas Open Data Portal)
sources.license: Public domain: the Comptroller's policy page states that information on its sites is public domain and may be copied and used as permitted by law. The dataset itself carries no license field on the portal
sources.redistribution: Permitted (public domain statement); attribution: Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts
sources.notes: Dataset 9cir-efmm 'Active Franchise Taxpayers' (Tax Code ch. 171): taxpayer number, legal name, mailing address, organisational type, SOS file number and status, NAICS. Updated about monthly (last 2026-10-31). The classic /api/views/<id>/rows.csv export is marked deprecated by the platform, so the v3 export URL is used. The portal platform's own terms (socrata.com/terms-of-service) could not be read as text and should be reviewed by a person (backlog A11). robots.txt: Crawl-delay 1; /browse?…&q= is disallowed, so the dataset page is used instead of a search.

sources.license: CC0-1.0 (stated by the publisher's API for the 2026 Land Parcels collection)
sources.notes: Blocked: data.geographic.texas.gov answers 403 (CloudFront 'Request blocked') to the collector and to plain curl, so the 254 county zips (stratmap26-landparcels_<fips>_lp.zip, GDB/SHP) cannot be downloaded without a browser. The API on api.tnris.org works and lists them. Ask TxGIO for a download route for automated clients before enabling; do not work around the block (data policy §1).
